overview: Echo Caverns is a sprawling subterranean megastructure beneath Luclin’s surface. Its crystal chambers amplify sound, creating dangerous resonance phenomena.
history: Originally natural caverns, Echo Caverns expanded as Shadow Haven miners and explorers carved new tunnels. During the Terror of Luclin era, resonance anomalies intensified, creating unstable sonic chambers.
hooks: A resonance chamber destabilizes, causing sonic shockwaves.
Shadow Haven miners uncover a new crystal biome.
Predators migrate from Deep Warrens into Lower Caverns.
A fungal bloom spreads rapidly, choking off travel routes.
The Resonance Core pulses with unexplained arcane energy.
